title: Litany of the Holy Spirit
text:
Lord, have mercy on us.
Christ, have mercy on us.
Lord, have mercy on us.
Christ, hear us.
Christ, graciously hear us.
God the Father of Heaven, have mercy on us.
God the Son, Redeemer of the world, have mercy on us.
God the Holy Spirit, have mercy on us.
Holy Trinity, One God, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, proceed from the Father and the Son, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, equal to the Father and the Son, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, Lord and Giver of life, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, who dwells in us, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, sanctifier of the Church, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, director of souls, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, power of the Most High, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, finger of God's right hand, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, breath of the Almighty, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, burning fire of love, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, dispenser of heavenly gifts, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of truth, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of wisdom, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of understanding, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of counsel, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of fortitude, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of knowledge, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of piety, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of the fear of the Lord, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of grace, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of charity, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of joy, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of peace, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of patience, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of kindness, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of goodness, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of long-suffering, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of mildness, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of fidelity, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of modesty, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of continency, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, spirit of chastity, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, comforter, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, sanctifier, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, who formed Christ in the womb of the Virgin Mary, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, who descended upon Jesus at His baptism, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, who led Jesus into the desert, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, who descended upon the apostles at Pentecost, have mercy on us.
Holy Spirit, who fills the Church with Your gifts, have mercy on us.
Lamb of God, Who takes away the sins of the world, send us Your Holy Spirit.
Lamb of God, Who takes away the sins of the world, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon us.
Lamb of God, Who takes away the sins of the world, may the grace of the Holy Spirit abide in us.
Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful,
And kindle in them the fire of Your love.
Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created,
And You shall renew the face of the earth.
Let us pray:
O God, Who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that by the gift of the same Spirit we may be always truly wise, and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

translation.latin:
Domine, miserere nostri.
Christe, miserere nostri.
Domine, miserere nostri.
Christe, audi nos.
Christe, exaudi nos.
Pater de caelis, Deus, miserere nobis.
Fili, Redemptor mundi, Deus, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, Deus, miserere nobis.
Sancta Trinitas, unus Deus, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, a Patre Filioque procedens, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, Patri Filioque coaequalis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, Domine et vivificator, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, qui in nobis habitas, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, Ecclesiae sanctificator, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, director animarum, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, virtus Altissimi, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, dexterae Dei digitus, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, flatus Omnipotentis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, ignis ardens amoris, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, largitor caelestium donorum, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus veritatis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus sapientiae, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus intellectus, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus consilii, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus fortitudinis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus scientiae, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus pietatis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus timoris Domini, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus gratiae, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus caritatis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus gaudii, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus pacis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus patientiae, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus benignitatis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus bonitatis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus longanimitatis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus mansuetudinis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus fidei, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus modestiae, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus continentiae, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, spiritus castitatis, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, Consolator, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, Sanctificator, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, qui Christum in utero Virginis Mariae formasti, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, qui super Iesum in Baptismo descendisti, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, qui Iesum in desertum duxisti, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, qui super Apostolos in Pentecoste descendisti, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte, qui Ecclesiam donis tuis reple, miserere nobis.
Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, mitte nobis Spiritum Sanctum.
Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, effunde in nos Spiritum Sanctum.
Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, det nobis sanctificationem Spiritus Sancti.
Veni, Sancte Spiritus, reple tuorum corda fidelium,
Et tui amoris in eis ignem accende.
Emite Spiritum tuum, et creabuntur,
Et renovabis faciem terrae.
Oremus:
Deus, qui corda fidelium Sancti Spiritus illustratione docuisti, da nobis in eodem Spiritu recta sapere, et de eius semper consolatione gaudere. Per Christum Dominum nostrum. Amen.

attribution: Traditional litany of the Church; often attributed to Cardinal Mercier
notes: The Litany of the Holy Spirit invokes the Third Person of the Blessed Trinity under His many titles and gifts. It includes the seven gifts of the Holy Spirit (wisdom, understanding, counsel, fortitude, knowledge, piety, and fear of the Lord) and the twelve fruits of the Holy Spirit (charity, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, long-suffering, mildness, fidelity, modesty, continency, and chastity). This litany is especially appropriate during Pentecost, during preparation for Confirmation, and when seeking the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
description: A litany invoking the Holy Spirit under His many titles, gifts, and fruits
